# Daily AI Eval - 2026-10-07 (~6:55 AM PT)

**Answer: MIXED.** Reliability is a little better (app ok_rate 7d excluding guard/snapshot rows 73.7% -> 75.4%; since Mon's report 20/22 app calls ok). Cost got worse on Tuesday: an in-place Hermes switch to deepseek-v4-pro (9:12-9:41 AM PT Tue, session "Start ai editor code tuning") pushed the OpenRouter day to $2.18 over the $1.65 cap before the guard tripped. Hermes thrash trips are frequent (13 since Mon's report) but now land on free Super Grok.

## Budget
- **OpenRouter** (auth_key, 6:45 AM PT): day $0.00/$1.65 (UTC day since Tue 5 PM PT), week $3.54/$11.50, month $22.80/$50, balance $14.23 (was $17.28). Billed since Mon's report $3.05 vs Hermes estimate ~$0.63 for 2 days -> under-logged ~5x, consistent with v4-pro routed to Relace (cached tokens billed at full input price). Tuesday's day cap was breached ($2.18 at 9:40 AM PT).
- **Super Grok**: last reading Shanta's "40" (taken as 40% used, Tue Oct 6 7:01 AM PT). Add-on meter has not reported since the Mon Oct 5 Firefox restart (23.7h stale). App estimate from 61 Hermes xai calls: ~43% used, ~57% left, reset Thu Oct 8 10:31 AM PT (~28h). Hermes default is now xai-oauth/grok-build-0.1, so hard coding is on Super Grok; keep it there until the reset.
- **Grok Bot** (estimate; last meter reading Tue Oct 6 7:01 AM PT = 12% used, reset ~Mon Oct 12 8:03 AM PT): observed burn 1% -> 12% in ~23h = ~11.5%/day; with the known ~3%/day undercount, ~14.5%/day. Unmetered since the reading: Tue 7:00-7:25 usage-monitor fixes task, this chat through ~1:49 PM Tue, likely CSC developer/HelpDesk wakes ~8:46 AM Tue, and this eval. Estimated now ~23-27% used, ~5.05 days left, soft room ~14.8%/day. Projected at reset ~83% (11.5%/day) to ~98% (14.5%/day). EARLY WARNING: the conservative pace lands near 100%, so one heavy day would push past it. Needs a fresh reading.
- **CSC developer HelpDesk line**: no separately measurable Bot cost since Mon; folder activity ~8:46 AM PT Tue suggests at least one wake, counted inside the estimate above. Queue: 25 open, no changes (watcher 6:31 AM PT today).

## Scorecard
- App calls since Mon 6:50 AM PT (excluding 51 guard trip/restore and provider_snapshot rows): 22 real, 20 ok (90.9%); chat 15/17 on north-mini-code:free and 1 Super Grok; 2 errors = Ollama phi4:14b "model not found". Cost $0.019.
- 7d app ok_rate 75.4% (52/69) vs 73.7% last report. Failover 14d 12.5%, answered after failover 4.
- App thrash: none. Anomalies only old gemma/nemotron error spikes (already out of chains).
- Hermes 2d: 10 sessions, models grok-build-0.1 (6), north-mini:free (2), grok-4.7 (1), deepseek-v4-pro (4, via in-place switch Tue), v4-flash (6). Est ~$0.63. Fallback chain is Super Grok > north-mini:free > nemotron-lightning:free > Ollama; no fallback-to-v4-pro from an invalid ID seen.
- Overrun guard: 13 trips since Mon's report (12 thrash, 1 day-cap Tue 9:40 AM PT), all auto-restored; latest trip 6:25 AM PT today, restored 6:40. Guard targets are valid IDs (xai-oauth/grok-build-0.1 on thrash, openrouter/cohere/north-mini-code:free on caps). Live session now: "Add picture item and barcode scanning to inventory" (grok-build, 40 calls).
- Tasks: aisystem commits Mon PM (bfa0bdd84 /ai/usage TT parse fix, c2fa5b529 gitignore runtime data, merge ab27b0bd7); Tue usage-monitor fixes applied uncommitted; Hermes finished ServerFallback util, AI editor tuning session and image-inventory plan.

## Proposals (new)
1. Super Grok guard handoff target is deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro (reason config_still_overrun_free); switch it to deepseek-v4-flash-0731 or a :free model while Relace bills cache at full price.
2. Warn or block in-place /model switches to v4-pro when the OpenRouter day is near cap (Tue's switch cost ~$2).
3. Don't trip on thrash when the session is already on Super Grok (12 of 13 trips swapped grok-build for itself).
4. Remove phi4:14b from the Ollama chain or pull it (2 not-found errors).
5. Reload the grok.com add-on so the Super Grok meter is fresh before Thu's reset.

## Carried forward
- Cap runaway single Hermes sessions (tool_loop_guardrails), unreviewed.
